notes:
FC-01 OPERATOR OVERRIDE corpus, program 4 of 8 (Amazing, BASIC).
SCOPE: this upstream listing (AMAZING.bas sha 3f6fa3f2...) is generation-and-print
ONLY - banner, dimension INPUT, random maze generation, maze print, END. There is
NO player walk / direction-INPUT phase, so AMAZ-00 is a PURE-PUT program and
console_input is the bare ^Z (the earlier assumption of a walk phase is FALSIFIED,
kept as written in LEARNINGS 2026-11-03 AMAZ-00 hop start; PROTOCOL #2).
ADAPTATION / DOCUMENTED UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE CHANGES (removal/substitution list):
(1) TAB(28)/TAB(15) banner (BASIC 10/20) DROPPED - no counted PUT;
FILE.PUT_POSITION/counted EDIT refused (EDIT-00 measures the counted refusal).
(2) Dimension INPUT (BASIC 100) and the MEANINGLESS-DIMENSIONS retry (102-104)
DROPPED: CHARACTER console GET is UNMEASURED; H = 4, V = 4 are DECLARED literal
FIXED constants instead (declared substitution, not hidden).
(3) The 2-D arrays W(H,V), V(H,V) (BASIC 110) are flattened to w(16)/vv(16) with
index (r-1)*4 + s - AGG.MULTIDIM is a pinned refusal (Batch-A).
(4) RND REPLACEMENT (declared): every INT(RND(1)*k+1) draw becomes the HAMM-00
idiom gg = gg + 1; t1 = gg*37 + 11; x = t1 - (t1/k)*k + 1 with LITERAL divisors
4/3/2 only (variable DIV is MEASURED refused on my compiler, HAMM-00 rev1). Seed
gg0 = 0 declared. The sequence has period 12 mod 12, so exactly 12 distinct mazes
exist per grid (measured in the independent scratch simulator over gg0 0..885 and
5x4/4x5/6x4 sweeps to 400).
(5) ON X GOTO dispatch became if ladders (HANG-00 pattern); the generator is a
flat goto state machine in one block mirroring the BASIC line numbers in label
names (sel/carve/print map 1:1; TRAN.GOTO_SAME_BLOCK run-witnessed from HANG-00).
(6) MEASURED MY-COMPILER PORT SHAPES (not DR claims): a condition may not contain
a member reference - every visited test loads t1 = w(b) first (member-in-
condition refuses); subscripts must be a simple variable or variable+1 [C159], so
the up/left/down moves go through b2 = b - 4 / b - 1 / b + 4 temporaries; the
BASIC <>0 tests are rewritten as measured = 0 forms (ordered compare with
constant 0 is refused); vv updaters use the default-store + conditional-
overwrite form (vv(b) = 3; if t1 = 0 then vv(b) = 2;) avoiding ELSE.
(7) SEPARATOR LAW ADAPTATION (declared, same as HANG-00): under the MEASURED
leading-blank law (one blank precedes every PUT LIST item that is not the first
since the last line start, ACROSS statements - Batch-A PASS captures, DR goldens
golden/e32rt_E32B1 == e32b_E32B1_dr) the border, cell and wall rows render
SPACE-separated single-item literals; collapse-spaces-v1 keeps the stream honest
and the wall structure (I vs blank, :-- vs :  ) survives the collapse.
(8) FRAMING: BASIC 30 has 4 PRINTs and 120/130/140/150 four more => 8 bare PUT
SKIP => expectation STARTS with 8 blank lines [C352]; the final PRINT '.'
(BASIC 1071) closes its line and the exit CRLF [C352] yields ONE trailing blank
line - 18 normalized lines total. The earlier 4-leading/no-trailing reading is
FALSIFIED, kept as written (PROTOCOL #2).
(9) EXIT BRANCH UNREACHED: with gg0 = 0 the walk always ends z = 1 (the BASIC 960
quirk fires first), so the exit-open draw 1011..1014 NEVER runs and the bottom-
border exit gap at column 3 comes from 980 (code-0 stuck cell -> 1); n980 = 1,
n975 = 0; 12 draws total, gg_final = 12; all 37 BASIC labels are covered by the
port's reachable paths.
(10) DERIVED ASSERTIONS (reference.py, never captured): C terminates at H*V+1 =
17, w is a permutation of 1..16, vv values in {0..3}, entrance gap at column 1
(measured; the simulator's earlier column-2 report was a sim bug - FALSIFIED and
corrected), z = 1, 1011..1014 unreached, bottom gap at column 3, and BFS from the
entrance reaches all 16 cells (connectivity). The derivation was diffed BYTE-EQUAL
against the independent instrumented simulator build/fc01-scratch/amaz00_sim.py
BEFORE this JSON was written (LEARNINGS 2026-11-02 AMAZ-00 implementation hop).
(11) First lane-B RUN of the flat goto generator and of nested DO TO print loops
with if/else single-item PUTs (both COMPILE-witnessed pre-pin at rc=0, 5760 B
code=3166 data=58); expected stream derived from the declared design via
reference.py:amaz00, never captured (L3); a FAIL stays classified, never
laundered.
